abstract:
[RSS 2026] Code for RISE: Self-Improving Robot Policy with Compositional World Model

# 🌏 RISE ## 📢 News - **`2026/Jun/03`** ❗❗❗ Please pull the latest code for important bug fixes. - **`2026/Mar/27`** 🚀 RISE got accepted to RSS 2026. - **`2026/Mar/22`** Training code and pre-trained dynamics model are released. - **`2026/Feb/11`** Paper released on [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11075). ## 🔥 Highlights - **A compositional world model.** A principled design that combines a controllable multi-view dynamics model with a progress value model, yielding informative advantages for robust policy improvement. - **RL in imagination.** A scalable self-improving framework that bootstraps robot policies through imaginary rollouts, avoiding the hardware cost and laborious reset of real-world interactions. - **Real-world manipulation gains.** Non-trivial performance improvements on challenging dexterous tasks, including +35% on dynamic brick sorting, +45% on backpack packing, and +35% on box closing. ## 🗺️ Overview RISE repository is structured with three major parts: - `policy_and_value/policy_offline_and_value`: OpenPI-based offline policy and value training. They are put together since they share similar model architecture and training pipeline. - `dynamics/dynamics_model`: Action-conditioned dynamics model. - `policy_and_value/policy_online`: Online RL for policy improvement. ## 🧑‍💻 Getting Started - [💻 Installation](docs/installation.md) - [🏆 Offline Policy Training & Value Model](docs/offline_learning.md) - [🔮 Dynamics Model](docs/dynamics_model.md) - [🦾 Online Policy Training](docs/online_training.md) - [🛠️ Deployment on Piper](docs/deploy.md) ## ❤️ Acknowledgement We thank the following projects for their open-source contributions: [OpenPI Pi0 / Pi05](https://github.com/openpi/openpi), [Genie Envisioner](https://github.com/AgibotTech/Genie-Envisioner), [RLinf](https://github.com/RLinf/RLinf), [LTX-Video](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-Video), [Kai0](https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/kai0). ## 📄 License and Citation All assets and code in this reposito
abstract_zh: 我们提出RISE，一个自我改进的机器人策略框架，其核心是组合世界模型：将可控多视角动力学模型与进度价值模型相结合，为策略改进提供信息丰富的优势。通过在想象中进行强化学习，RISE避免了真实交互的硬件成本和繁琐重置，实现了可扩展的自我改进。在真实世界的灵巧操作任务中，RISE取得了显著提升，包括动态积木分拣+35%、背包打包+45%和关箱+35%。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出 RISE：用「可控多视角动力学模型 + 进度价值模型」组成组合式世界模型，在想象中做 rollout 进行在线 RL，从而自举式地持续改进机器人策略，无需真实硬件反复交互。


# 一、动机

> 真实世界强化学习训练机器人策略需要昂贵的硬件交互和繁琐的环境重置，难以规模化；现有世界模型又缺少可用于策略改进的可靠优势估计。


# 二、方法

> 提出 RISE：用「可控多视角动力学模型 + 进度价值模型」组成组合式世界模型，在想象中做 rollout 进行在线 RL，从而自举式地持续改进机器人策略，无需真实硬件反复交互。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在多个高难度灵巧操作任务上取得显著提升：动态分拣砖块 +35%、装背包 +45%、关箱子 +35%；消融显示组合式世界模型比单一动力学模型能提供更有信息量的 advantage，策略可从 OpenPI 离线模型在线自举提升。


# 四、对我的启发

> 核心局限在于想象 rollout 与真实物理之间仍存在模型偏差（imagination gap），效果高度依赖动力学模型的保真度与多视角一致性，长时序任务的误差累积尚未验证；对具身智能课题有直接启发：用世界模型替代真实交互是降低真机 RL 成本的可扩展路径。
